title: 第一百五十五章斩杀安家老祖第一百五十四章降临安家
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: “找死！”
“阴阳逆转，生死轮回拳！”
初祖手上拂尘一挥，一枚拳印朝着反方向砸了过去。
阴阳逆转，李长寿只觉得脚步一沉，被一股空间之力包裹。
等他回过神来，已经被传送到拳印面前。
这样的空档让他根本无法防备，被一拳打飞了出去。
李长寿只是合体期，大乘巅峰的一击还是让他感到异常疼痛，像是被一座大山砸了一下，体内骨骼发出噼里啪啦的脆响。
“天魔老祖，我这由阴阳法则凝聚的力量，感觉如何呢！”
初祖轻蔑一笑。
经过这一击之下，他已经探出了李长寿的虚实。
攻击有着大乘期的力量，防御却不怎么样。
简单来说不过是仗着顶级灵器帝兵，真要打起来对方也不过尔尔。
尽管是这样，他也不敢大意，能够杀死安逸和两名大乘长老，必然还有所倚仗。
“你的攻击确实厉害，不过你的同伴怕是坚持不了多久了。”
阴阳之力可逆转身为，转移攻击。
只要还身处大阵，他便可以使用其中威能。
作为拥有阴阳灵器的李长寿相当清楚。
在不燃烧寿命的情况下打起来着实费力。
当然他也不需要燃烧寿元，只需要等傲雪和龙煞解决完另一名安家老祖，一切都可迎刃而解。
安家初祖顺着目光看去，只见安家二祖被两条巨龙疯狂蹂躏，从天上打到地下，从地下又打到地底。
到处都是碎裂的虚空和破碎的法则，完全就是单方面的碾压。
“老二，你怎么样？”初祖察觉到情况不妙。
龙族战力远超同级，本以为是灵魂体就会被削弱，没想到还是大大超出了他的预料。
“还撑得住，大哥快速解决他，我可还在坚持半炷香。”
话说着，二祖因为分身被一击神龙摆尾从天上砸到地上，就像是一道完美的抛物线，溅起大量尘土。
砰！
两头巨龙身上暗黑法则狂涌，追了上去。
“老二！”
初祖眉头微蹙，整个人勃然大怒，再度挥动手上拂尘：“阴阳颠倒，无相本印！”
李长寿再度被阴阳之力强行转移，一枚古朴大印如太古神山般就要砸在他的身上。
已经吃过一次亏，作为李老六岂能没有防备。
他高举五行之剑，催动剑威对着上方射出五道光柱。
金木水火土五种元素之力，五色神光撼动天穹，轰在大印之上。
只听轰隆一声巨响，原本能够覆盖整个阴阳棋盘的大印被硬生生轰开了一个缺口。
李长寿目光如电，身化雷霆钻了过去，他站在虚空上，轻蔑一笑。
“老东西，你的力量很不错，要是能够填充我的尊魂幡，想必能够成为我不错的手下。”
“你也别得意，仅仅凭你合体期的实力催动帝兵，所消耗必然也不小，看你还能催动几次！”
初祖深知老二撑不了多久，彻底疯魔，各种毁灭性的异象如陨石坠落，疯狂砸了上去。
李长寿抵御得尤为吃力，灵气不到片刻便被抽空，面色变得惨白。
好在他手中有大量恢复丹药，外加尊魂幡中有不少大乘期的冤魂。
冤魂疯狂自爆，挡住了安家初祖的攻击。

"Seeking death!"
"The reversal of yin and yang, the reincarnation fist!"
The First Ancestor waved the whisk in his hand, and a fist mark hit in the opposite direction.
The yin and yang reversed, and Li Changshou felt his footsteps sink as he was enveloped by a force of space.
When he came to his senses, he had been teleported to the fist seal.
Such a gap made him unable to defend himself at all, and he was punched and sent flying.
Li Changshou was only in the integration stage, but the blow from the peak of Mahayana still made him feel abnormal pain, as if he had been hit by a big mountain, and the bones in his body made a crackling sound.
"Ancestor Heavenly Demon, how do you feel about my power condensed by the law of yin and yang!"
The First Ancestor smiled contemptuously.
After this blow, he had discovered Li Changshou's reality.
The attack has the power of the Mahayana stage, but the defense is not so good.
To put it simply, they are just relying on the top-level spiritual weapons of the imperial soldiers. If they really want to fight, the opponent will be mediocre.
Even so, he did not dare to be careless. If he could kill An Yi and the two Mahayana elders, he must have something to rely on.
"Your attack is indeed powerful, but your companions may not be able to hold on for long."
The power of yin and yang can reverse the body and deflect attacks.
As long as he is still in the formation, he can use its power.
As a possessor of yin and yang spiritual weapons, Li Changshou knew it very well.
It's really hard to fight without burning the lifespan.
Of course, he doesn't need to burn his longevity. He just needs to wait for Aoxue and Longsha to finish killing the other Anjia ancestor, and everything will be solved easily.
The first ancestor of the An family followed his gaze and saw that the second ancestor of the An family was being ravaged wildly by two giant dragons, beating them from the sky to the ground, and from the ground to the ground.
There are shattered voids and broken laws everywhere, and it is completely a one-sided crushing.
"Second brother, how are you?" The first ancestor noticed that the situation was not good.
The combat power of the Dragon Clan was far superior to that of the same level. He thought that the soul body would be weakened, but unexpectedly, it was far beyond his expectations.
"You can still hold on. Big brother will deal with him quickly. I'm still holding on to half a stick of incense."
As he said this, the Second Ancestor was struck from the sky to the ground by the dragon's tail swing, like a perfect parabola, splashing a lot of dust.
Bang!
The dark laws surged from the two giant dragons and they chased after them.
"Dick!"
The First Ancestor frowned slightly, and became furious. He waved the fly whisk in his hand again: "Yin and Yang are reversed, the original seal without form!"
Li Changshou was forcibly transferred by the power of yin and yang again, and a simple seal was about to hit him like an ancient sacred mountain.
Having already suffered a loss, how could Li Laoliu be unprepared?
He raised the Five Elements Sword high and activated the power of the sword to shoot five beams of light upward.
The power of the five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, and the five-color divine light shook the sky and struck the great seal.
There was a loud bang, and a gap was opened in the large seal that could have covered the entire Yin-Yang chessboard.
Li Changshou's eyes were like lightning, and he turned into thunder and rushed over. He stood in the void and smiled contemptuously.
"Old guy, your power is very good. If you can fill my soul flag, you will definitely become a good subordinate of mine."
"Don't be complacent. Just relying on your strength in the integration stage to activate the imperial soldiers will definitely consume a lot of money. Let's see how many times you can activate them!"
The First Ancestor knew that the second child could not last long, so he went completely crazy, and all kinds of destructive phenomena were like falling meteorites, hitting him crazily.
Li Changshou's resistance was particularly difficult. His spiritual energy was drained out in less than a moment, and his face turned pale.
Fortunately, he had a large amount of recovery elixirs in his hands, and there were many wronged souls from the Mahayana period in the soul-honoring flags.
The wronged soul exploded crazily, blocking the attack of the ancestor of the An family.
